name: G_N26_C11_S29_P901_001
changed_witness_selection: First changed row with complete G1, verified receipt and a subsequent load at the requested destination; otherwise first changed row with explicit missing links.

scopes.selector: Per scored callback: current validation, action features and frozen selector forward. Excludes candidate building, forecast generation, native submission and audit IO.
scopes.planner: All recorded initial callbacks, including warmup and no-candidate calls: base planner, candidate/forecast preparation and selector; excludes subsequent audit sink and native submission. Residual calls are not captured in this distribution.
scopes.audit: Recorded callback hashing, JSON encoding, gzip write/flush and index append. Stream close and receipt-file write are not separately timed.
scopes.sum: Measured planner plus callback audit persistence only; not a claim of full controller or end-to-end latency.
scopes.worker_elapsed: Worker segment elapsed is cumulative since worker start. Use the last value; never sum cumulative segment elapsed values.
scopes.replay: Offline verification timing is separate from original online selector measurements.

limitations: G1 certifies chosen request/entity, delivered positive ACK and first edge, not full task success.
Receive and next-load links are checked against raw native evidence; a later same-tray load is not an isolated causal benefit estimate.
No full-population cost comparison or learned-policy benefit inference is performed here.
Fixed-weight replays sample first scored, first changed and chosen witness callbacks; all stream hashes and all saved execution joins are checked.
Recorded timing scopes are distinct; none alone certifies a 100ms controller SLA.
